theorems.name: Submission.idtp_cse_ah_countable_separating_tests
theorems.statement: ∀ c d : ℝ, ∃ F : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ, (∀ n, ContDiff ℝ 1 (F n)) ∧ (∀ n, tsupport (F n) ⊆ Ioo c d) ∧ ∀ w : ℝ → ℝ, IntegrableOn w (Ioo c d) → (∀ n, ∫ α, F n α * w α = 0) → ∀ᵐ α, α ∈ Ioo c d → w α = 0
